title: GitHub Activity
description: Shows your latest GitHub activity in Discord RPC. Displays pushes, PRs, issues, releases and more. Slides through multiple info panels with timestamps.
author: Devollox

title: Steam Activity
description: Fetches your current Steam game from your public Steam profile page and shows it in Discord RPC. Updates every 60 seconds.
author: Devollox

title: Hardware Monitor (native)
description: Shows CPU, GPU and RAM stats in Discord RPC using systeminformation. Replaces the builtin hardware plugin with a native npm module approach.
author: Devollox
